import {
	Breadcrumb,
	BreadcrumbItem,
	BreadcrumbLink,
	BreadcrumbList,
	BreadcrumbPage,
	BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb";
import { ComponentIcon, HomeIcon } from "lucide-react";

export default function Component() {
	return (
		<Breadcrumb>
			<BreadcrumbList>
				<BreadcrumbItem>
					<BreadcrumbLink
						href="#"
						className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
					>
						<HomeIcon size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
						Home
					</BreadcrumbLink>
				</BreadcrumbItem>
				<BreadcrumbSeparator />
				<BreadcrumbItem>
					<BreadcrumbLink
						href="#"
						className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
					>
						<ComponentIcon size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
						Components
					</BreadcrumbLink>
				</BreadcrumbItem>
				<BreadcrumbSeparator />
				<BreadcrumbItem>
					<BreadcrumbPage>Breadcrumb</BreadcrumbPage>
				</BreadcrumbItem>
			</BreadcrumbList>
		</Breadcrumb>
	);
}
